title: Shinonome Akito — Two Hearts' Resonant Roar〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: ASTRO FES - Day 2
ASTRO FES Venue

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We already finished rehearsal, but there's quite a bit of time until the show.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Now's probably my chance to eat something. The performance isn't until tonight, so I better grab a bite...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I think I'll check out the food stalls since—)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Heya, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wow, look at all these people!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa! Len, KAITO... What if someone saw you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe. We're not in sight, so it's A-okay!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Huh? Is Toya not with you?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I think he's checking out the food stalls and stuff with Sena...one of the idols we're performing with.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Right... So that means you're alone and free!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Want us to tag along and check out the stalls with you, Akito?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, pretty sure you were just looking for an excuse to ask that... But, I don't mind the company.

rows.Speaker: Len & KAITO
rows.Line: <Yay!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Now that I think about it... There're stalls selling food from all different countries and areas.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess it's 'cause this festival is about enjoying all kinds of music and food.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Really?! There's a lot of food I've never seen before, it's so interesting.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh! Look, Akito! That food stall is selling massive meat skewers!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, you don't get to eat it like that. When you order it, they slice some of the meat off for you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hahaha. Someone's feeling a little hungry.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Oh! Is that the famous Turkish ice cream?
Wow, it actually does stretch apart!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hypocrite, much?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (These two sure are excited.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But they're probably not satisfied with just looking. I'll grab something for them later.)

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line:
Oh, there he is!
Hey, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Sazanami?
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Sorry for calling out to you all of a sudden. I was wondering if you're up for grabbing a bite together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, sure. That sounds great—

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Huh? Someone's calling me. Who is it...?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I knew it.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, especially after just calling out to you. Would you mind waiting a bit? I'll make it quick.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No problem.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: What is it, Ohiisan?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line:
What?!
Are you serious? You know I've got my own plans— Hey!

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: And he hangs up once he's done asking for a favor. This guy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is there something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Oh... I guess you could say that. Ohiisan just asked me to get some food for him.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: He said I should show him some hospitality because he came all the way to cheer me on despite being so busy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ohiisan... Isn't he...

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Yes, Hiyori Tomoe. He's the fellow member of Eden I mentioned yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Well, we actually also work together as the duo act, Eve. So you could say he's my partner in crime of sorts.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Ah. Speak of the devil. Ohiisan just sent me a grocery list.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line:
Let's see... “Salmon quiche, black tea, clam chowder...”
Isn't he asking for a little too much?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds like...a lot of work.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Haha, I'm used to it.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Besides... I'm happy to do this stuff half of the time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: I'm pretty free whenever I don't have work, so it helps me take a breather... And I mentioned this yesterday as well, but I'm indebted to Ohiisan.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: I wouldn't be who I am now if he didn't take me in. I want to return the favor in some way.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Which is why I indulge his requests... And try to show how much I've grown when we sing together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How much you've grown?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Yes. I think in Ohiisan's eyes, showing my progress and how far I've come is the ultimate token of gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Growth, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I understand how it feels to want to improve and be better for your teammates.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya can do so many things I can't.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Since we became partners, I've been doing everything I can to keep being worthy of singing next to him.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Haha, I completely understand. It's hard when your partner is amazing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess that's why we're always working towards getting better.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: After chatting with you about this, it sounds like we really do have a lot in common.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: To get even better than we are right now, let's give it our all during our performance!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It sounds like those two get along really well!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yeah. I'm itching to see everyone's performance even more now.>

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Alright, I better start working on Ohiisan's requests... But would you like to join me, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: So, I heard that Cinnamon has a stall here. I called out to you initially to ask if you're keen to check it out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Cinnamon... That's the cafe in Ensemble Square, right?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: That's right. According to some of the other idols, the special international menu they worked up is really good.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure quiches were on the menu too. Since I need to grab one for Ohiisan, I thought I could kill two birds with one stone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (If the other idols say it's good, then it's worth trying... I have a feeling Len and KAITO would be interested in the international menu too.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, I'll take you up on your offer. I might get stuff for some good friends who've helped me out a lot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Good friends who've helped him out... Is he talking about us?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Akito...!>

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Great! Then, let's go!
A few hours later - Before the show
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: The time has come, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes. We got along on many fronts, Sazanami...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And that's why, I'm going in for the win.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Right back at you. I'll be sure to tell you about the view from up above.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm going to make you eat those words.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Alright, let's not hold our punches♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You got it!
